description: Reusable receipt template for onboarding a human wallet into QPF/OINIO. Copy this file, rename with the wallet identifier, fill in the fields, and commit.
instructions: 3. Choose one ROLE from the roles list below
5. Commit with message: 'receipt(governance): read-only onboarding v1 for {controller} {role}'
6. Seal milestone with a governance receipt after onboarding is complete

supporter_wallet.description: Someone supporting the project. No authority. No claims.

builder_wallet.description: Someone contributing work. No deployment or fund authority.

observer_wallet.description: Watching governance or activity. No voting power.

donor_wallet.description: Provided past support. No ongoing obligation. No control.

foundation_candidate_wallet.description: Under consideration for a foundation role. No authority until explicit verification and legal steps.

trust_candidate_wallet.description: Under consideration for a trust-related role. No authority until explicit verification.

personal_support_wallet.description: Personal support from an individual. No foundation or public claim.

wallet.claimed_controller: REQUIRED: name or pseudonym of the wallet provider
wallet.control_statement: REQUIRED: statement from the provider confirming wallet control
wallet.permission_statement: REQUIRED: permission boundary from the provider

next_required: optional signed message proving wallet control
separate verified foundation wallet if foundation onboarding is requested
human approval before any financial movement

principle: Trust can be honored without movement. Support can be recorded without custody. Verification comes before value flow.
